Name: AI Tooling in Practice

The loop below is how the work runs day to day. Inputs on the left, Claude Code in the middle with MCP, Obsidian, and reusable skills around it, outputs on the right.

Name: About This Agent
Body_Technical__c: This agent runs on Agentforce in a Salesforce Developer Edition org Dean set up for his portfolio. Its answers come from three custom objects (Resume Section, Resume Credential, Resume Engagement) loaded from resume.json, the same file his resume page is built from, through four Apex actions: Get Resume Profile, Find Experience by Keyword, Get Credentials, and Capture Inquiry. It never names a client, because the data holds none. The Agent Script, Apex, tests, and seed script are in his portfolio gallery. A second assistant on his resume page does the same job on Claude behind a Cloudflare Worker, so the two stacks can be compared.
Body_Plain__c: This assistant runs on Salesforce's AI agent product, Agentforce, in a practice Salesforce account Dean set up for his portfolio. Everything it knows comes from his resume, loaded into Salesforce from the same file his resume page is built from. It can look up his experience, list his certifications, and pass a message to him. It never names a client, because that information is not in it. Dean built a second assistant on his resume page that does the same job with Claude, so you can compare the two.
